observation.command: printf '%s\n' 'loc=$(curl -sS -c $JAR -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" "http://localhost:3000/app/" 2>>$OUT)' 'echo "step1=$loc" >> $OUT' '[ -z "$loc" ] && { echo FAIL >> $OUT; cat $OUT; exit 1; }' 'code=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-login.html -w "%{http_code}" "$loc" 2>>$OUT)' 'echo "step2=$code" >> $OUT' >> /tmp/fa.sh; echo "part2 ok"
